The PROTECT protective helmet is a sports product designed to provide safety and protection during rugby practice. This helmet is designed to fit any gender, making it ideal for players of both sexes.

The helmet features a rear adjustment system that can be regulated by an elastic cord, allowing for a personalized and comfortable fit for each user. Additionally, it has a chin strap with velcro closure that ensures the helmet stays in place during the game.

The padded panels of the helmet provide an additional layer of protection, absorbing impacts and reducing the risk of injuries. These panels also have perforations for ventilation, ensuring proper air circulation and preventing the buildup of heat and sweat.

The PROTECT helmet offers high protection, thanks to its composition of quality materials. It is mainly made of 74% EVA, 13% lycra, and 13% polyester. These materials ensure the durability and resistance of the helmet, as well as its ability to adapt to the shape of the user's head.

In summary, the PROTECT protective helmet is a sports product specifically designed to provide safety and protection during rugby practice. With its personalized adjustment system, padded panels, and quality materials, this helmet ensures optimal protection, breathability, and adaptability for players.

Le casque de protection PROTECT est un produit sportif conçu pour offrir sécurité et protection lors de la pratique du rugby. Ce casque est conçu pour s'adapter à tous les genres, ce qui le rend idéal pour les joueurs des deux sexes.

Le casque est doté d'un système de réglage arrière qui peut être ajusté à l'aide d'un cordon élastique, permettant un ajustement personnalisé et confortable pour chaque utilisateur. De plus, il dispose d'une fermeture à bande auto-agrippante au niveau du menton garantissant que le casque reste en place pendant le jeu.

Les panneaux rembourrés du casque offrent une couche supplémentaire de protection, absorbant les chocs et réduisant le risque de blessures. Ces panneaux comportent également des perforations pour la ventilation, assurant une circulation d'air adéquate et évitant l'accumulation de chaleur et de transpiration.

Le casque PROTECT offre une protection élevée grâce à sa composition de matériaux de qualité. Il est fabriqué principalement avec 74% d'EVA, 13% de lycra et 13% de polyester. Ces matériaux garantissent la durabilité et la résistance du casque, ainsi que sa capacité à s'adapter à la forme de la tête de l'utilisateur.

En résumé, le casque de protection PROTECT est un produit sportif conçu spécifiquement pour offrir sécurité et protection lors de la pratique du rugby. Avec son système de réglage personnalisé, ses panneaux rembourrés et ses matériaux de qualité, ce casque assure une protection optimale, une respirabilité et une adaptabilité pour les joueurs.

The Protect protective helmet is a sports product designed to provide safety and comfort during rugby practice. This unisex helmet features a rear adjustment with an elastic cord, allowing it to be easily adapted to different head sizes. In addition, it has a Velcro closure on the chin to ensure a secure fit.

The helmet is made of high-quality materials that offer excellent protection. The padded panels provide an additional layer of cushioning, reducing the impact of potential blows. It also features strategically placed perforations to promote ventilation and prevent heat buildup.

The main feature of this helmet is its combination of protection and breathability. This allows the user to feel comfortable and secure during sports practice, without compromising the necessary ventilation to maintain an adequate temperature.

The Protect helmet is composed of 86% polyester and 14% spandex on the outside, giving it great strength and flexibility. The padding is made of 200% EVA, a material known for its impact absorption capacity. In addition, the inner lining is made of 100% polyester, providing a soft and comfortable feel when in contact with the skin.
